meals.name: Bacon & broccoli pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the vegetables for the last 3 min.
Fry the bacon crisp. Whisk the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

meals.name: Potato & pepper frittata
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 min, then slice.
Fry the potatoes, onion and pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour over the eggs beaten with salt and pepper. Cook on low heat 8 min.
Top with the cheese and finish under the oven grill until set.

meals.name: Biksemad with fried egg
steps: Dice the potatoes small and fry them in most of the oil for 15–20 min until golden and cooked through.
Fry the diced meat and onion in another pan, then mix everything and season with salt and pepper.
Fry one egg per person in the last of the oil and put it on top.

meals.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Fry chopped onion, garlic and grated carrot in the oil for 5 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer 20–25 min.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water and toss with the sauce.

meals.name: Sausage & vegetable soup
steps: Fry the sliced sausage and leek in the oil.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, the tomatoes and 1 l water.
Simmer 25 min and season with salt and pepper. Keeps 4 days.

meals.name: Rye bread with leverpostej
steps: Spread the leverpostej on two slices of rye.
Top with sliced cucumber.

meals.name: Rye bread with cheese & veg
steps: Butter two slices of rye and add the cheese and vegetables.

meals.name: Egg & cheese toast
steps: Fry the egg in the butter with a pinch of salt.
Toast the bread with the cheese on top until melted, and put the egg on top.

meals.name: Bread roll with cheese
steps: Halve and toast the roll, butter thinly.
Add the cheese and sliced vegetables.

meals.name: Cottage cheese on rye
steps: Top two slices of rye with the cottage cheese.
Add sliced vegetables and a pinch of salt.
